Trimmed fixtures for tests/unit/adapters/mui.test.ts (no network in tests). Source-code excerpts carry a
`.txt` suffix so the TypeScript/ESLint project never compiles or lints them; they are read as text only.

- `*.api.json`, `*.tr.json`, `pages.ts`, `pagesApi.js`, `react-button.js`, `buttons.md`, `speed-dial.md`,
  `skeleton.md`, `progress.md`: excerpts of github.com/mui/material-ui at tag v9.5.0
  (`joy-button.api.json` at v5.17.1). MIT License, Copyright (c) 2014 Call-Em-All.
- `blue.mjs`, `common.mjs`, `orange.mjs`, `createPalette.mjs`, `createTransitions.mjs`, `zIndex.mjs`:
  excerpts of npm @mui/material@9.5.0. MIT License, Copyright (c) 2014 Call-Em-All.
- `joy-colors.js`, `joy-extendTheme.js`: excerpts of npm @mui/joy@5.0.0-beta.52. MIT License,
  Copyright (c) 2014 Call-Em-All.
- `baseui-*.mdx`, `baseui-accordion.types.md`: excerpts of github.com/mui/base-ui at tag v1.9.0.
  MIT License, Copyright (c) 2019 Material-UI SAS.
